title: EN 18223:2026 DigitalProductPassport — compressed JSON serialisation (clause 5.2)
description: A digital product passport serialised as clause 5.2 prescribes: the nine Table 1 header attributes (seven mandatory) and, beside them, every data element under its elementId as the key — its dictionaryReference and valueDataType omitted because the data dictionary holds them (5.2.2). OpenDPP-authored from the clauses of EN 18223:2026 — the standard publishes examples and an XSD, not a JSON Schema — and NON-NORMATIVE: a conformance aid, not a verdict.

digitalProductPassportId.description: The identifier of this DPP instance (4.1.2.1 recommends a URI/URL).

uniqueProductIdentifier.description: The unique product identifier the passport describes (EN 18219).

granularity.description: The level the identifier addresses: model, batch or item. BOTH spellings pass: 4.1.2.2's prose enumerates the lower-case values, the clause 5.2.4 example spells them capitalised, and the standard is not consistent with itself. The kit's SHACL shape takes the stricter prose reading, so a capitalised value passes here and fails there — deliberately; see schemas/README.md.

dppSchemaVersion.description: The version of the DPP schema the document follows.

dppStatus.description: The status of this digital resource (an open vocabulary).

lastUpdated.description: When the passport was last changed (ISO 8601, Table 7 xsd:dateTime).

economicOperatorId.description: The identifier of the responsible economic operator (EN 18219 clause 6).

facilityId.description: The identifier of the manufacturing facility, when known (optional).

contentSpecificationIds.description: The content specifications whose data elements the body carries (optional).
